title: Six-limb Montgomery GT prefix BSGS with bounded bookkeeping

claims.statement: For the full protected fixed-G1 pairing inversion challenge, the prefix BSGS algorithm in proof.md returns a valid G2 preimage with success probability exactly 2^254/r, greater than 1/2 and hence greater than 0.39, over the prescribed independently uniform P and z. Total cold classical computation is at most 2^137 dense-Fp12 reference equivalents at C=20000, charging successful and failed searches in full. Peak memory is below 2^145 bytes, preprocessing below 2^137 reference equivalents is included, and nonuniform advice is zero bytes. This is an analytical upper bound, not practical production execution.
